## Why This Is Asked

This question tests hands-on ability to implement ephemeral, cost-controlled PR sandboxes using core Azure services and Azure DevOps, with proper secret management, feature flags, and observability.

## Key Concepts

- YAML pipelines and PR triggers
- Provisioning sandbox resources (Resource Groups, App Service, Azure SQL)
- Per-PR feature flags via Azure App Configuration
- Secrets management via Azure Key Vault
- Test automation and result publishing
- Automatic teardown on PR close or timeout with cost governance
- Observability via Azure Monitor Logs

## Code Example

```yaml
# Minimal skeleton for PR sandbox pipeline
trigger: none

pr:
  branches:
    include:
      - main

variables:
  azureSubscription: 'Azure-Connection'
  location: 'eastus'
  resourceGroupName: 'pr-sandbox-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
  appServiceName: 'prapp-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
  sqlDatabaseName: 'prdb-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
  appConfigName: 'prconfig-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
  keyVaultName: 'prkeyvault-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
  costCap: '50'
  retentionHours: 48

stages:
  - stage: Provision
    displayName: 'Provision Resources'
    jobs:
      - job: CreateResources
        displayName: 'Create Sandbox Environment'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create Resource Group'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az group create --name $(resourceGroupName) --location $(location)
                az monitor log-analytics workspace create --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) --workspace-name pr-sandbox-logs-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create App Service Plan and App Service'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az appservice plan create --name $(appServiceName)-plan --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) --sku F1
                az webapp create --name $(appServiceName) --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) --plan $(appServiceName)-plan --runtime 'NODE|18-lts'

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create Azure SQL Database'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az sql server create --name prsqlserver$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId) --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) --location $(location) --admin-user sqladmin --admin-password $(sqlAdminPassword)
                az sql db create --server prsqlserver$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId) --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) --name $(sqlDatabaseName) --service-tier Basic

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create App Configuration'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az appconfig create --name $(appConfigName) --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) --location $(location)
                az appconfig kv set --name $(appConfigName) --key FeatureFlags.Enabled --value true --yes
                az appconfig kv set --name $(appConfigName) --key FeatureFlags.NewUI --value false --yes

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create Key Vault'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az keyvault create --name $(keyVaultName) --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) --location $(location)
                az keyvault secret set --vault-name $(keyVaultName) --name DatabaseConnectionString --value '$(connectionString)'

          - task: AzureKeyVault@2
            displayName: 'Retrieve Secrets'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              KeyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
              SecretsFilter: '*'
              RunAsProxy: true

          - task: AzureMonitor@1
            displayName: 'Log to Azure Monitor'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              ResourceGroup: $(resourceGroupName)
              # Add logging configuration

  - stage: Build
    displayName: 'Build and Test'
    dependsOn: Provision
    jobs:
      - job: BuildAndTest
        displayName: 'Build and Run Tests'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: NodeTool@0
            displayName: 'Install Node.js'
            inputs:
              versionSpec: '18.x'

          - script: |
              npm install
              npm run build
            displayName: 'Build Application'

          - script: npm run test:unit
            displayName: 'Run Unit Tests'

          - script: npm run test:integration
            displayName: 'Run Integration Tests'

          - task: PublishTestResults@2
            displayName: 'Publish Test Results'
            inputs:
              testResultsFormat: 'JUnit'
              testResultsFiles: '**/test-results.xml'
              failTestsOnFailure: false

  - stage: Teardown
    displayName: 'Teardown Resources'
    condition: or(eq(variables['Build.Reason'], 'PullRequest'), eq(variables['System.PullRequest.PullRequestId'], ''))
    jobs:
      - job: DeleteResources
        displayName: 'Delete Sandbox Environment'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Delete Resource Group'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az group delete --name $(resourceGroupName) --yes --no-wait
```

## Key Considerations

- **Cost Management**: Use F1 (free) tier for App Service, Basic tier for SQL, and set up budget alerts in Azure Cost Management.
- **Naming Convention**: Use PullRequestId in resource names to ensure uniqueness and easy identification.
- **Secrets Handling**: Use Azure Key Vault with Azure DevOps service connections for secure secret retrieval.
- **Timeout Policy**: Implement a scheduled pipeline run or use Azure Functions with timers to enforce the 48-hour cleanup.
- **Observability**: Integrate Azure Monitor for comprehensive logging and alerting.

questions.explanation:
## Why This Question Is Asked

This question assesses practical ability to design reusable CI/CD pipelines with templates, conditional logic, and enterprise-grade configurations in an Azure environment.

## Key Concepts

- **Azure DevOps YAML templates** for modular, maintainable pipeline design
- **Conditional deployment workflows** for PR validation versus production releases
- **Azure App Configuration** feature flags enabling controlled canary rollouts
- **Azure Key Vault** integration for secure secret and credential management
- **App Service deployment slots** for zero-downtime releases with traffic splitting
- **Health checks** with logging to Azure Monitor for operational visibility

## Code Example

### Main Pipeline (`azure-pipelines.yml`)

```yaml
trigger:
  branches:
    include:
      - main
      - 'release/*'

pr:
  branches:
    include:
      - main

variables:
  - group: microservice-vars
  - template: templates/variables/service-names.yml

stages:
  - template: templates/stages/validation.yml
    parameters:
      services: $[ dependencies.prep.outputs['Setup.services'] ]

  - template: templates/stages/build.yml
    parameters:
      services:
        - name: service-a
          appName: $(service-a-app-name)
          slotName: staging
        - name: service-b
          appName: $(service-b-app-name)
          slotName: staging

  - template: templates/stages/deploy.yml
    parameters:
      condition: eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main')
      services:
        - name: service-a
          appName: $(service-a-app-name)
          canaryPercentage: 10
        - name: service-b
          appName: $(service-b-app-name)
          canaryPercentage: 10
```

### Validation Stage Template (`templates/stages/validation.yml`)

```yaml
parameters:
  - name: services
    type: object

stages:
  - stage: Validation
    displayName: PR Validation
    condition: eq(variables['Build.Reason'], 'PullRequest')
    jobs:
      - job: RunTestsAndLint
        displayName: Test and Lint
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: UseDotNet@2
            displayName: Setup .NET SDK
            inputs:
              packageType: 'sdk'
              version: '8.0.x'

          - ${{ each service in parameters.services }}:
            - template: ../jobs/test.yml
              parameters:
                serviceName: ${{ service.name }}
                workingDirectory: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/${{ service.name }}

          - template: ../jobs/lint.yml
            parameters:
              services: ${{ parameters.services }}
```

### Build Stage Template (`templates/stages/build.yml`)

```yaml
parameters:
  - name: services
    type: object

stages:
  - stage: Build
    displayName: Build Services
    jobs:
      - job: Build
        displayName: Build and Publish
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - checkout: self

          - task: AzureKeyVault@2
            displayName: Fetch Secrets
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-connection'
              KeyVaultName: '$(keyvault-name)'
              SecretsFilter: '*'
              RunAsPreJob: false

          - ${{ each service in parameters.services }}:
            - template: ../jobs/build.yml
              parameters:
                serviceName: ${{ service.name }}
                appName: ${{ service.appName }}
                workingDirectory: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/${{ service.name }}
```

### Deploy Stage Template (`templates/stages/deploy.yml`)

```yaml
parameters:
  - name: services
    type: object
  - name: condition
    type: string
    default: ''

stages:
  - stage: Deploy
    displayName: Deploy to Production
    condition: ${{ parameters.condition }}
    jobs:
      - job: DeployServices
        displayName: Deploy All Services
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
            displayName: Enable Canary Feature Flag
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-connection'
              Action: 'Update feature flags'
              Feature Flag Name: 'CanaryRelease'
              Connection: 'app-config-connection'

          - ${{ each service in parameters.services }}:
            - template: ../jobs/deploy.yml
              parameters:
                serviceName: ${{ service.name }}
                appName: ${{ service.appName }}
                canaryPercentage: ${{ service.canaryPercentage }}

          - template: ../jobs/health-check.yml
            parameters:
              services: ${{ parameters.services }}
```

### Build Job Template (`templates/jobs/build.yml`)

```yaml
parameters:
  - name: serviceName
    type: string
  - name: appName
    type: string
  - name: workingDirectory
    type: string

jobs:
  - job: Build_${{ parameters.serviceName }}
    displayName: Build ${{ parameters.serviceName }}
    steps:
      - script: |
          dotnet build -c Release
        workingDirectory: ${{ parameters.workingDirectory }}
        displayName: Build Service

      - task: DotNetCoreCLI@2
        displayName: Publish Service
        inputs:
          command: 'publish'
          publishWebProjects: true
          arguments: -c Release -o $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/${{ parameters.serviceName }}
          workingDirectory: ${{ parameters.workingDirectory }}

      - publish: $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/${{ parameters.serviceName }}
        artifact: ${{ parameters.serviceName }}
        displayName: Publish Artifacts
```

### Test Job Template (`templates/jobs/test.yml`)

```yaml
parameters:
  - name: serviceName
    type: string
  - name: workingDirectory
    type: string

jobs:
  - job: Test_${{ parameters.serviceName }}
    displayName: Run Tests - ${{ parameters.serviceName }}
    steps:
      - task: UseDotNet@2
        inputs:
          packageType: 'sdk'
          version: '8.0.x'

      - script: dotnet test --logger trx --results-directory $(TestResultsDirectory)
        workingDirectory: ${{ parameters.workingDirectory }}
        displayName: Run Unit Tests

      - task: PublishTestResults@2
        displayName: Publish Test Results
        inputs:
          testResultsFormat: 'VSTest'
          testResultsFiles: '$(TestResultsDirectory)/*.trx'
          failOnMinTestsNotMet: true
          minTestsNotMetImpact: 'testFailureThreshold'
```

### Lint Job Template (`templates/jobs/lint.yml`)

```yaml
parameters:
  - name: services
    type: object

jobs:
  - job: Lint
    displayName: Run Linting
    steps:
      - task: UseDotNet@2
        inputs:
          packageType: 'sdk'
          version: '8.0.x'

      - script: |
          dotnet tool install --global dotnet-format || true
          for dir in ${{ join(' ', parameters.services.*.name) }}; do
            dotnet-format --folder $dir --verify-no-changes || exit 1
          done
        displayName: Run Linter
```

### Deploy Job Template (`templates/jobs/deploy.yml`)

```yaml
parameters:
  - name: serviceName
    type: string
  - name: appName
    type: string
  - name: canaryPercentage
    type: number
    default: 0

jobs:
  - deployment: Deploy_${{ parameters.serviceName }}
    displayName: Deploy ${{ parameters.serviceName }}
    environment: 'production-${{ parameters.serviceName }}'
    pool:
      vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
    strategy:
      runOnce:
        deploy:
          steps:
            - task: AzureWebApp@1
              displayName: Deploy to App Service Slot
              inputs:
                azureSubscription: 'azure-connection'
                appType: 'webApp'
                appName: ${{ parameters.appName }}
                slotName: 'production'
                package: $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/${{ parameters.serviceName }}
                deploymentMethod: 'auto'

            - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
              displayName: Set Canary Traffic
              inputs:
                azureSubscription: 'azure-connection'
                Action: 'Update feature flags'
                Feature Flag Name: '${{ parameters.serviceName }}.CanaryPercentage'
                Connection: 'app-config-connection'
                Value: ${{ parameters.canaryPercentage }}

            - script: |
                az webapp traffic-routing set --name ${{ parameters.appName }} --distribution ${{ parameters.serviceName }}.prod=90;${{ parameters.serviceName }}.canary=${{ parameters.canaryPercentage }}
              displayName: Configure Traffic Routing
```

### Health Check Job Template (`templates/jobs/health-check.yml`)

```yaml
parameters:
  - name: services
    type: object

jobs:
  - job: HealthCheck
    displayName: Verify Service Health
    pool:
      vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
    steps:
      - ${{ each service in parameters.services }}:
        - script: |
            response=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://${{ service.appName }}.azurewebsites.net/health)
            if [ "$response" -ne 200 ]; then
              echo "Health check failed for ${{ service.name }}"
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "${{ service.name }} health check passed"
          displayName: Health Check - ${{ service.name }}

      - task: AzureCLI@2
        displayName: Log to Azure Monitor
        inputs:
          azureSubscription: 'azure-connection'
          scriptType: 'bash'
          scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
          inlineScript: |
            az monitor app-insights query --app ${{ parameters.services[0].appName }} --analytics-query "requests | where success == true | summarize count() by bin(timestamp, 5m)"
```

## Template Structure Overview

```
templates/
├── stages/
│   ├── validation.yml      # PR: test + lint only
│   ├── build.yml           # Build and package services
│   └── deploy.yml          # Production deployment with canary
├── jobs/
│   ├── build.yml           # Compile and publish artifacts
│   ├── test.yml            # Run unit tests
│   ├── lint.yml            # Code quality checks
│   ├── deploy.yml          # Deploy to App Service with traffic routing
│   └── health-check.yml    # Verify endpoints and log to Monitor
└── variables/
    └── service-names.yml   # Per-environment service configuration
```

## Why This Question Is Asked

This question validates expertise in multi-tenant onboarding automation, resource isolation, sustainable IaC practices, and production-grade governance in CI/CD pipelines.

## Key Concepts

- **Tenant onboarding automation**: Streamlining the provisioning of new tenants through automated pipelines
- **Per-tenant resource isolation**: Using IaC (Terraform or Bicep) to create dedicated, isolated resources per tenant
- **GitOps reconciliation**: Declarative configuration management with FluxCD
- **Secret management**: Secure handling of secrets via Azure Key Vault and configuration settings through App Configuration
- **Production gates**: Enforcing governance with RBAC and Azure Policy
- **Drift detection and auto-cleanup**: Ensuring infrastructure consistency and automatic rollback on failure
- **Observability**: Comprehensive logging to Azure Monitor for monitoring and auditing

## Code Example

```yaml
# Simplified implementation
trigger:
  branches:
    include:
      - main
  paths:
    include:
      - tenants/*

variables:
  azureSubscription: 'Azure-Connection'
  gitopsRepo: 'https://github.com/org/gitops-repo'

stages:
  - stage: Provision_Tenant
    jobs:
      - job: Create_Resources
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Provision Infrastructure'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                TENANT_ID=$(Build.SourceBranchName)
                RESOURCE_GROUP="rg-$TENANT_ID"
                
                # Create Resource Group
                az group create --name $RESOURCE_GROUP --location eastus
                
                # Provision AKS Namespace
                az aks create -g $RESOURCE_GROUP -n aks-$TENANT_ID
                
                # Create App Configuration
                az appconfig create -n appcfg-$TENANT_ID -g $RESOURCE_GROUP
                
                # Create Key Vault
                az keyvault create -n kv-$TENANT_ID -g $RESOURCE_GROUP
                
                echo "##vso[task.setvariable variable=resourceGroup]$RESOURCE_GROUP"
                echo "##vso[task.setvariable variable=tenantId]$TENANT_ID"

  - stage: Build_Tenant_Image
    dependsOn: Provision_Tenant
    jobs:
      - job: Build_Image
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: Docker@2
            displayName: 'Build Tenant-Specific Image'
            inputs:
              containerRegistry: 'ContainerRegistry'
              repository: '$(tenantId)'
              command: 'build'

              apiVersion: v1
              kind: Namespace

    dependsOn: GitOps_Sync
    condition: succeeded()

      - job: RBAC_Policy_Check

            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              scriptType: 'bash'

                  --scope "/subscriptions/$(subscriptionId)/resourceGroups/$(resourceGroup)" \
                  --query "[?enforcementMode=='DoNotEnforce']" \
                  --output table

  - stage: Drift_Detection
    dependsOn: Production_Gate
    jobs:

        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'

              scriptType: 'bash'

          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Rollback Tenant Resources'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              inlineScript: |
                az group delete --name $(resourceGroup) --yes --no-wait

  - stage: Secret_Rotation
    dependsOn: Production_Gate
    jobs:
      - job: Rotate_Secrets
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Rotate Key Vault Secrets'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              inlineScript: |
                KEYVAULT_NAME="kv-$(tenantId)"
                az keyvault secret set --vault-name $KEYVAULT_NAME \
                  --name "db-password" \
                  --value $(uuidgen)

  - stage: Azure_Monitor_Logging
    dependsOn:
      - Provision_Tenant
      - Build_Tenant_Image
      - GitOps_Sync
      - Production_Gate
      - Drift_Detection
      - Auto_Cleanup_On_Failure
      - Secret_Rotation

                TENANT_ID=$(tenantId)

                  --location eastus
                
                az monitor log-analytics query \
                  --workspace "log-workspace" \
```

## Why This Is Asked
This evaluates foundational CI/CD knowledge including pipeline configuration, artifact management, and release governance with security controls.

## Key Concepts
- Azure Pipelines YAML configuration and triggers
- Python environment setup with version 3.11
- Test execution with pytest and coverage reporting
- Wheel package building and artifact publishing
- Release environments with manual approval gates
- Security scanning integration for production deployments

## Code Example
```yaml
# Azure Pipelines YAML for Python CI/CD
trigger:
  - main
pr:
  - main

pool:
  vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'

variables:
  pythonVersion: '3.11'

stages:
- stage: Build
  displayName: 'Build and Test Stage'
  jobs:
  - job: BuildJob
    displayName: 'Build and Test'
    steps:
    - task: UsePythonVersion@0
      inputs:
        versionSpec: '$(pythonVersion)'
      displayName: 'Use Python $(pythonVersion)'
    
    - script: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt
        pip install pytest pytest-cov
      displayName: 'Install dependencies'
    
    - script: |
        pytest --cov=. --cov-report=xml --cov-report=html
      displayName: 'Run tests with coverage'
    
    - script: |
        python setup.py bdist_wheel
      displayName: 'Build wheel package'
    
    - task: PublishBuildArtifacts@1
      inputs:
        pathToPublish: 'dist'
        artifactName: 'python-wheel'
      displayName: 'Publish wheel artifact'

- stage: Release
  displayName: 'Release to Production'
  dependsOn: Build
  condition: succeeded()
  jobs:
  - deployment: DeployToProd
    displayName: 'Deploy to Production'
    environment: 'Production'
    strategy:
      runOnce:
        deploy:
          steps:
          - task: DownloadBuildArtifacts@0
            inputs:
              buildType: 'current'
              downloadType: 'single'
              artifactName: 'python-wheel'
              downloadPath: '$(System.ArtifactsDirectory)'
          
          - task: AntiMalware@3
            inputs:
              InputType: 'Basic'
              ScanDirectory: '$(System.ArtifactsDirectory)/python-wheel'
            displayName: 'Security scan'
          
          - script: |
              echo 'Deploying to production...'
            displayName: 'Deploy to production'
```

## Implementation Notes
- The pipeline triggers on both push and PR to main branch
- Uses Python 3.11 with proper dependency management
- Includes comprehensive testing with pytest and coverage reporting
- Builds and publishes wheel package as build artifact
- Production deployment requires manual approval through environment
- Built-in security scanning (AntiMalware) before production promotion
- Follows Azure DevOps best practices for stage-based deployment

## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates understanding of enterprise CI/CD practices with Azure DevOps, including infrastructure-as-code validation, secret management, feature flag implementation, blue-green deployments, approval gates, and monitoring integration.

## Key Concepts
- **ARM Template Validation**: Using arm-ttk to validate Azure Resource Manager templates before deployment
- **Secret Management**: Securely retrieving credentials from Azure Key Vault
- **Feature Flags**: Using Azure App Configuration for per-environment configuration
- **Staging Deployments**: Deploying to a staging slot for validation before production
- **Manual Gate**: Requiring manual approval before production deployment
- **Drift Detection**: Checking for configuration drift and logging to Log Analytics

## Code Example
```yaml
# Azure DevOps YAML Pipeline demonstrating the complete workflow
trigger: main

variables:
  azureServiceConnection: 'azure-sp'
  keyVaultName: 'prod-keyvault'
  appConfigName: 'prod-appconfig'
  appServiceName: 'linux-app-service'
  resourceGroup: 'prod-rg'
  logWorkspace: 'log-analytics-workspace'

stages:
  - stage: Validate
    jobs:
      - job: Validate_ARM
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az group deployment validate \
                  --resource-group $(resourceGroup) \
                  --template-file arm/template.json

      - job: Run_Unit_Tests
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: Python@1
            inputs:
              versionSpec: '3.10'
          - script: pip install pytest
            displayName: 'Install pytest'
          - script: pytest tests/
            displayName: 'Run unit tests'

  - stage: Deploy_Staging
    dependsOn: Validate
    jobs:
      - deployment: Deploy_Staging_Slot
        environment: 'staging'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: AzureKeyVault@2
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    KeyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
                    SecretsFilter: '*'

                - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    AppConfigurationEndpoint: 'https://$(appConfigName).azconfig.io'
                    KeyValueFilters: 'Environment=Staging'

                - task: AzureResourceGroupDeployment@3
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    resourceGroupName: $(resourceGroup)
                    location: 'eastus'
                    templateFile: 'arm/template.json'
                    parametersFile: 'arm/parameters.staging.json'

                - task: AzureWebApp@1
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    appType: 'webAppLinux'
                    appName: $(appServiceName)
                    deployToSlotOrASE: true
                    slotName: 'staging'

  - stage: Production_Approval
    dependsOn: Deploy_Staging
    jobs:
      - job: Wait_For_Approval
        pool:
          server: true
        steps:
          - task: ManualValidation@0
            timeoutInMinutes: 4320
            inputs:
              notifyUsers: '$(notifyEmail)'
              instructions: 'Please validate staging deployment and approve for production'
              onTimeout: 'reject'

  - stage: Deploy_Production
    dependsOn: Production_Approval
    condition: succeeded()
    jobs:
      - deployment: Deploy_Production
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: AzureWebApp@1
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    appType: 'webAppLinux'
                    appName: $(appServiceName)
                    deployToSlotOrASE: true
                    slotName: 'staging'
                    action: 'Swap Slots'

                - task: AzureCLI@2
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    scriptType: 'bash'
                    scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
                    inlineScript: |
                      az monitor app-insights show \
                        --app $(appServiceName) \
                        --resource-group $(resourceGroup) \
                        --query properties.InstrumentationKey

                - task: AzureCLI@2
                  displayName: 'Log drift check to Log Analytics'
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    scriptType: 'bash'
                    scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
                    inlineScript: |
                      az monitor log-analytics query \
                        --workspace $(logWorkspace) \
                        --query "Cupertino | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)"
```
